description.value: Bonnie Martin Restaurant is a family-run diner in Chemainus, BC, serving home-style Canadian and Chinese cuisine since 1998. Open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner with all menu items available all day, it's a well-established local favourite offering everything from omelettes and eggs benny to burgers and steak. Eat-in and takeout options make it a practical stop for cyclists passing through Chemainus.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM name, address, and provides a phone number absent from OSM. The site confirms takeout service ('Eat in or order take-out for breakfast, lunch and dinner') and lists a Veggie Omelette as a vegetarian option. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, washrooms, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone 250 246 1068 sourced from website only.

Minor inconsistency across website pages: home/index pages describe cuisine as 'home-style Canadian cuisine' while the About page adds 'and Chinese cuisine' — About page wording appears more complete.
Minor price discrepancy between pages: single-egg Eggs Benedict listed at $13 on home/index pages but $14 on menu page, suggesting some pages may be slightly out of date.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, full-service restaurant offering dine-in and takeout for all three meals; a useful and welcoming stop for touring cyclists on the Chemainus stretch of the route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a Veggie Omelette ('Three-egg omelette with chopped veggies topped with cheddar cheese'). No vegan or gluten-free options explicitly identified
